nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon (two overlapping circles)
nodes.rationale: App icon: a pink circle and an orange circle overlapping on a near-black background, with the overlap blended. It suggests two people or partners coming together, which fits a couples/relationship app that tracks distance and mood.

nodes.label: Overlapping Circles Motif (Two Partners)
nodes.rationale: Venn-like union of pink (#ff7a90-ish) and orange/amber (#e8a94f-ish) circles on dark (#17131c-ish) background; brand mark for the PWA

nodes.label: PWA Home Screen Icon
nodes.rationale: Next.js app/apple-icon.png file convention auto-generates apple-touch-icon link used when installing the PWA on iOS
